patterns: APPSC favours feature questions: 'NOT a characteristic' (equally distributed), monsoon = secondary/seasonal winds within 20N-20S, distribution controlled by relief.
Local storms are an APPSC staple: mango showers (Kerala/coastal Karnataka), Kaal Baisakhi (West Bengal), dust storms in May, heat-wave months.
Rainfall extremes recur across PSCs: Leh/Jaisalmer driest, Cherrapunji/Mawsynram in Khasi Hills, Tamil Nadu winter rain from NE monsoon, western disturbances for NW plains.
APPSC G1 2024 tested Koeppen code-to-region matching; app covers it well.
App adds jet-stream/Tibet/OMT mechanism detail and many 2026 monsoon current-affairs items beyond PYQ depth.
